PYR was initially based on the Ethereum blockchain but has since migrated to Polygon. The Vulcan Forged is a platform that includes several blockchain games (VulcanVerse and Berserk being their most known ones), an exchange and, as was mentioned above, an NFT marketplace. Jamie Thomson is the CEO, and the company is headquartered in Athens, Greece. A team of dozens developers (with a few of them working in-house) is spread all over Europe: the list of countries include Greece, UK and Ukraine. The company cites its mission as being “committed to providing the best NFT Gaming experiences possible by offering engaging and entertaining games”, and “revolutionizing the blockchain gaming space.  The company also uses a secondary token, LAVA, which is mainly used for in-game transactions. LAVA is also offered as a reward to those who stake PYR and want to earn some in-game currency.   What are PYR’s key features and how does it work?  PYR plays an important role in all aspects of the Vulcan Forged operation. It is actively used both in blockchain games provided by Vulcan Forged as well as in the operation of the company's NFT marketplace. The PYR token is an important part of everything related to Vulcan Forged and powers the entire ecosystem.  PYR is used for:  Buying NFT and in-game assets;     Staking and liquidity mining (the rewards are paid in the platform’s secondary tokens, LAVA, that can be used for in-game interactions and transactions);    Maintaining in-game assets and raising their levels if needed;   Paying placement fees and fees for renting the NFTs for those who have a scholarship rank;      Access to NFT dApp incubation programs.  Where Can You Buy Vulcan Forged?  PYR tokens are available to buy on various platforms. The list includes Binance, Huobi Global, HitBTC, KuCoin, and Gate.io. They can be traded against stablecoins (USDT), cryptocurrencies like BTC, ETH and sometimes against FIAT.  Where Can You Store PYR?  PYR is supported by various wallets, with the official and recommended one being MyForge. Many wallets that support the Polygon blockchain are also compatible with the PYR token. Venly would be an example of such a cryptocurrency wallet.  PYR Transactions  Low transaction fees are listed as one of the reasons for migrating to Polygon mainnet from the Ethereum blockchain.  Liquidity Mining and Staking of PYR  PYR is not minable in the traditional sense of the word. Total supply is limited to 50 million tokens. However, PYR can be staked. It's an option in the VulcanVerse game. The rewards are usually paid in LAVA.  Historical events:  Vulcan Forged has been redeployed on Ethereum and Polygon. CrossWallet is the ultimate crypto wallet and DEX aggregator that lets you swap assets across chains with a single click. It allows you to track and manage all of your wallets across multiple blockchain networks, including ETH, BSC, TRON, BTC, and more.     Features  All of Your Assets in One App  Managing several unique addresses across multiple blockchains can quickly become overwhelming. Often, each blockchain requires its own wallet or requires the user to set up custom RPCs. Let’s face it: even when you know what you’re doing, it’s a hassle. With CrossWallet, you can access assets on all supported chains from a single interface that automatically connects to the blockchain you select without any complicated setup process.  Cross-Swap Capabilities  CrossWallet’s unique feature ’Cross Swap’ makes bridging assets across all available networks as easy as clicking a single button. Whether arbitrage trading or moving funds to access another network’s features, you can seize these opportunities with maximum efficiency, convenience, and speed. With CrossWallet, you can monitor prices and liquidity across multiple networks simultaneously to identify trading and arbitrage opportunities — and profit before everyone else.  Non-Custodial with Maximum Security  CrossWallet users remain in sole control of their private keys through a 256SHA encrypted key management system. The CrossWallet software will also work with hardware wallets, like Ledger and Trezor, for extra peace of mind. Only the user has access to their wallet and their funds.  Asset Management  CrossWallet implements a unique, all-in-one, cross-chain wallet presented in a fully-featured, slick user interface. It empowers users with a single tool to actually manage all of their assets and wallets across multiple networks, instead of just tracking their balances like most other wallet apps.     Token Utility  Governance  The CrossWallet token is used as a governance token that allows the community to influence the priority of project and blockchain integrations. Governance will also be used to set the price for special access NFTs. By making the pricing of NFTs adjustable, the system is more adaptable when the price of the $CWT token moves considerably in either direction because fees will not become too cheap or too expensive. While the governance mechanisms are being built and tested, we will use a community Forum to discuss integrations and fee adjustments.  Fee Sharing and Referrals  Through staking CrossWallet tokens, projects can earn a cut of the fees when their users use our wallet. This creates a financial incentive to suggest CrossWallet to their users, thereby setting in motion a positive feedback loop for user acquisition.  Purchasing CrossWallet Membership NFTs  Certain features and functions are only available for members who have a particular ACCESS NFT in their wallet. A member can purchase those NFTs only on the primary market with a set price with CrossWallet tokens. Users will have the ability to sell their MEMBER NFTs in any marketplace.  Additional Staking and Reward Opportunities  The CrossWallet token can be used to stake and earn rewards at an attractive APY to be determined in future governance model deliberations. The platform will allow for the possibility of both single asset staking of and multi asset staking and LP farming in conjunction with CrossWallet’s partners and newly integrated projects. As various staking models are experimented with, community feedback can be used to determine ‘best practices’ to provide users with the most desirable and profitable opportunities.

When traders open a position, the liquidity pool automatically takes the opposite position without exception, thus the traders executing trades against the liquidity pool. Everything Starts from Scalability: The Aark Flywheel  Unlike other platforms that cap their Open Interest to TVL (Total Value Locked) ratio below 1:1, Aark can scale over ten times the OI relative to its TVL.
